stem: Which line from the play shows a character reconsidering a personal belief?

options.label: B
options.text: MAURA: . . . To be honest, I forgot what they're fighting about. (line 10)

options.label: C
options.text: ROBERT: . . . She's talking about publishing the paper only once a month now. (line 21)

options.label: D
options.text: BELINDA: . . . And, in all fairness, his point about the newspaper wasn't wrong. (line 37)
